sentences.text: Issue notice to respondent returnable on 5th June 2023.
Learned A.P.P. waives service for the respondents.
It pertains to making forgery of entries in the revenue record.
It is informed that a civil suit is pending between the informant and the main accused (accused No.1).

In view of the same, till next date, in the event of arrest of applicant in connection with Crime No.454/2020, registered with Badnapur Police Station, District Jalna for offence punishable under Sections 465, 466, 467, 468, :: 2 ::
